opennyai_summary.14_July_2022__decision:
This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection with CR No.709/2021, registered at Bharti Vidyapeeth Police Station, Pune, for the offences punishable under Sections 272, 273, 188 and 328 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ("the Penal Code") and Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(d) and 27(3)(e) read with Section 3(i)(zz)(v) and 30(2)(a) of the Foods Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
3. The matters in which an identical issue of the applicability of the provisions of Section 328 of the Penal Code arises are 902-ABA1899-2022.DOC posted for consideration on 5th August, 2022.
In the circumstances, list this matter on 5th August, 2022.
In the meanwhile, in the event of arrest of the applicant in C.R. No.709 of 2021, registered with Bharati Vidyapeeth Police Station, Pune, he be released on bail on furnishing a P. R. Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/-, with one or two sureties in the like amount.
5. The applicant shall cooperate with the investigation and report to the Investigating Officer as and when directed.
